name: de-employee-income-tax
description: Use this skill for the annual German income tax return of an employee resident in Germany (Einkommensteuererklärung with Anlage N), tax year 2026, filed in 2027. Covers when an employee must file (§ 46 EStG: tax classes III/V or IV with factor, side income or wage replacement benefits over EUR 410, several employers) and when filing is voluntary (four years), the 2026 tariff, Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag, Werbungskosten (commuting allowance at EUR 0.38 from the first km, home office day allowance, work equipment, training, union dues), Vorsorgeaufwendungen, Kinderfreibetrag against Kindergeld, Ehegattensplitting, single parent relief, household services (§ 35a), extraordinary burdens, solidarity surcharge, church tax, deadlines, late-filing surcharge and interest. Trigger on: Steuererklärung Arbeitnehmer, Anlage N, Werbungskosten, Pendlerpauschale, Homeoffice-Pauschale, Lohnsteuer Erstattung, tax refund Germany employee, Steuerklasse III V Pflichtveranlagung, Splittingtarif.
